title: Observation, Evidence and Truth
hook: Signals are observations. None of them may authorize anything.
thesis: The episode separates three layers engineers blur: observation (a signal arrived), evidence (a verified, attributable record), truth (what the canonical state says happened). It shows why the convergence work's key finding matters publicly: signals are observations, opportunity scores are recommendations, audience clusters are projections, experiments update confidence, and none may authorize publication, spending, or external effects merely because a score is high. The growth engine must never become an authority.

proven: The directive states OBSERVATION != EVIDENCE and the signals/recommendations/projections separation (sections 4, 26).
The directive states the editorial grammar PROVEN / WIRED_UNPROVEN / NOT PROVEN / NEEDS-REVERIFY / UNKNOWN (intro).
partial: The exact verification path that turns an observation into evidence in the current system.
unknown: Concrete public examples beyond the growth-engine case.

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
